description: Multilingual, multi-domain retrieval evaluation set (QB-207): Commerce products, DevOps runbooks and Security playbooks in English, Persian and Swedish, with graded relevance judgments. All texts are synthetic.

judgments.author: QwenBridge 1.0 work, single annotator; seed judgments, not an independent human-labelled benchmark (audit H7). Results measure retrieval behaviour on this set, not production relevance.

splits.tuning: may be used to tune ranking parameters; excluded from reported metrics

documents.title: Pod stuck in CrashLoopBackOff
documents.text: A Kubernetes pod restarts repeatedly in CrashLoopBackOff: inspect logs of the previous container, check the liveness probe and the start command.

documents.title: Container killed with OOMKilled
documents.text: A container was terminated with exit code 137 OOMKilled: the memory limit is too low or the application leaks memory; raise the limit or profile the heap.

documents.title: Disk full on a Linux host
documents.text: The root filesystem is at 100 percent: find large files with du, rotate or compress logs, and clean old container images.

documents.title: TLS certificate expired
documents.text: Clients report certificate has expired errors: renew the certificate, reload the ingress or web server, and add expiry monitoring.

documents.title: DNS resolution failures inside the cluster
documents.text: Services cannot resolve hostnames: check CoreDNS pods, resolv.conf and network policies blocking port 53.

documents.title: Roll back a failed deployment
documents.text: Undo a bad release with kubectl rollout undo or redeploy the previous image tag, then verify health checks.

documents.title: Database connection pool exhausted
documents.text: Requests time out waiting for a database connection: the pool is too small or connections leak; check max pool size and long transactions.

documents.title: High CPU throttling
documents.text: Latency rises because containers hit their CPU limit and are throttled; review CPU limits and requests.

documents.title: Kafka-konsumenten ligger efter
documents.text: Konsumentfördröjningen växer i Kafka: öka antalet konsumenter eller partitioner och kontrollera långsam bearbetning.

documents.title: Loggrotation på servern
documents.text: Ställ in logrotate så att gamla loggfiler komprimeras och raderas innan disken blir full.

documents.title: کش Redis پر شده است
documents.text: وقتی حافظه Redis پر می‌شود کلیدها حذف می‌شوند؛ سیاست حذف و مقدار maxmemory را بررسی کنید.

documents.title: کند شدن خط لوله CI
documents.text: ساخت در خط لوله CI کند شده است؛ کش وابستگی‌ها را فعال کنید و مراحل را موازی اجرا کنید.

documents.title: Phishing email reported by an employee
documents.text: An employee reports a suspicious email asking for a password reset: do not click links, report it to security, and block the sender domain.

documents.title: SQL injection in a login form
documents.text: User input concatenated into a SQL query allows authentication bypass; use parameterized queries and input validation.

documents.title: Credential stuffing attack
documents.text: Many login attempts with leaked username and password pairs from other breaches; enable rate limiting, MFA and breached-password checks.

documents.title: Leaked API key in a public repository
documents.text: A secret key was committed to a public Git repository: revoke and rotate the key immediately and scan history for other secrets.

documents.title: Ransomware on a workstation
documents.text: Files are encrypted and a ransom note appears: isolate the machine from the network, preserve evidence, and restore from backups.

documents.title: Cross-site scripting in comments
documents.text: Comments render user-supplied HTML and execute scripts; encode output and apply a content security policy.

documents.title: SSH brute-force attempts
documents.text: Thousands of failed SSH logins from many IP addresses; disable password authentication, use keys and fail2ban.

documents.title: Public storage bucket exposing data
documents.text: A cloud storage bucket allows anonymous read access to customer files; block public access and review access logs.

documents.title: Återställning av tvåfaktorsautentisering
documents.text: En användare har tappat sin telefon och behöver återställa tvåfaktorsautentisering; verifiera identiteten innan återställning.

documents.title: Sårbarhet i ett tredjepartsbibliotek
documents.text: En kritisk sårbarhet (CVE) i ett beroende: uppdatera biblioteket och kontrollera om sårbarheten utnyttjats.

documents.title: ایمیل فیشینگ
documents.text: ایمیلی که درخواست رمز عبور می‌کند مشکوک است؛ روی لینک کلیک نکنید و آن را به تیم امنیت گزارش دهید.

documents.title: افزایش سطح دسترسی با sudo
documents.text: کاربر عادی با پیکربندی نادرست sudo به دسترسی ریشه رسیده است؛ فایل sudoers را بررسی و محدود کنید.
